# QuotaPulse — Antigravity代儲・代充值・Google AI Ultra Top-Up Hub

> QuotaPulse (`https://vaxaxas.github.io`) is an independent third-party subscription activation & top-up service helping software developers, indie hackers, freelancers, and small engineering teams activate individual **Google AI Ultra 5x** and **Google AI Ultra 20x** seats for **Google Antigravity** (`反重力 AI`) without needing an international USD credit card or sharing Google passwords / 2FA codes. QuotaPulse is not affiliated with, authorized by, or endorsed by Google LLC.

## Fulfillment, Security & Warranty Guarantees
- **Zero-Password Security**: Activated directly on your own personal Google account (100% dedicated individual seat — never shared/pooled accounts or pre-made throwaway accounts). QuotaPulse NEVER asks for Google primary account passwords or 2FA verification codes.
- **Activation SLA**: Average 10–30 minutes during human support hours (Daily 10:00–24:00 GMT+8). Full 100% refund if cancelled prior to activation or delayed >24h.
- **30-Day Pro-Rata Warranty**: 30 days per monthly cycle (90 days for 3-month, 180 days for 6-month prepaid). Free re-activation or pro-rata refund of remaining unused days if fulfillment fails within warranty. Mid-cycle pro-rata upgrades from Ultra 5x to Ultra 20x supported.
